target.description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_cld_w0.md, section 7 (W0 with the exceptions stated in its section 8.3): loss of a dilute coflow flame by blow-off, and its radiometer excess. Time origin of loss: flame onset. The planned fuel-off (planned_fuel_off_from_onset, seconds since onset) is declared as the scheduled stop, which the typed edits of section 7.4 address. Derived case inputs (the most severe fraction and coflow of the schedule, the first constant-flow stage, the window and the stop) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py. (PhaseEndTime is the first target with a shared quantity); targets: loss, radiometer
excludes: cld:radiometer (positive, V): lane-local target, not a shared quantity

features.name: x_fuel_final
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_fuel_final.centre) / x.x_fuel_final.scale; refused unless x.x_fuel_final.lo <= x <= x.x_fuel_final.hi @1

features.name: v_coflow_final
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.v_coflow_final.centre) / x.v_coflow_final.scale; refused unless x.v_coflow_final.lo <= x <= x.v_coflow_final.hi @1

features.name: window
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.window.centre) / x.window.scale; refused unless x.window.lo <= x <= x.window.hi @1

features.name: is_ethylene
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_ethylene.centre) / x.is_ethylene.scale; refused unless x.is_ethylene.lo <= x <= x.is_ethylene.hi @1

features.name: x_fuel_stage
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.x_fuel_stage.centre) / x.x_fuel_stage.scale; refused unless x.x_fuel_stage.lo <= x <= x.x_fuel_stage.hi @1

features.name: v_fuel_stage
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.v_fuel_stage.centre) / x.v_fuel_stage.scale; refused unless x.v_fuel_stage.lo <= x <= x.v_fuel_stage.hi @1

tensors.name: loss.blowoff.median.b0

tensors.name: loss.blowoff.median.skip
tensors.description: Linear weights of ln(median time of cause blowoff of loss alone / 1 s), since the time origin on z, in feature order; every element is stated.

tensors.name: loss.blowoff.median.W1
tensors.description: Hinge input weights of ln(median time of cause blowoff of loss alone / 1 s), since the time origin; row j reads z in feature order.

tensors.name: loss.blowoff.median.b1
tensors.description: Hinge biases of ln(median time of cause blowoff of loss alone / 1 s), since the time origin (hinge positions).

tensors.name: loss.blowoff.median.w2

tensors.name: radiometer.spread.b0
tensors.description: Value of the ln-sd of the core component of radiometer at z = 0 before hinge terms (1).

tensors.name: radiometer.spread.skip
tensors.description: Linear weights of the ln-sd of the core component of radiometer on z, in feature order; every element is stated.

tensors.name: radiometer.spread.W1
tensors.description: Hinge input weights of the ln-sd of the core component of radiometer; row j reads z in feature order.

tensors.name: radiometer.spread.b1
tensors.description: Hinge biases of the ln-sd of the core component of radiometer (hinge positions).

tensors.name: radiometer.spread.w2
tensors.description: Hinge output weights of the ln-sd of the core component of radiometer.

tensors.name: radiometer.tail_weight
tensors.description: Weight of the wider component of radiometer (0: one log-normal).

tensors.name: radiometer.tail_width
tensors.description: ln-sd of the wider component of radiometer over that of the core (1: no wider component).

tensors.description: Integration steps per requested interval of an event target (numerical, not physics).

notes: Generic law forward law.rs, declaration configs/models/law/cld/decl.json (status Declared): {"slug":"cld","status":"declared","family":"other","investigation":"PSI-21, ACME CLD Flame: methane and ethylene coflow flames diluted with nitrogen, on a 2.18 mm tube in a 25 mm air annulus","description":"W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_cld_w0.md, section 7 (W0 with the exceptions stated in its section 8.3): loss of a dilute coflow flame by blow-off, and its radiometer excess. Time origin of loss: flame onset. The planned fuel-off (planned_fuel_off_from_onset, seconds since onset) is declared as the scheduled stop, which the typed edits of section 7.4 address. Derived case inputs (the most severe fraction and coflow of the schedule, the first constant-flow stage, the window and the stop) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.","features":[{"name":"x_fuel_final","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"lowest fuel fraction the script reaches (section 7.1)"},{"name":"v_coflow_final","unit":"m/s","transform":"ln","description":"highest coflow speed the script reaches (section 7.1)"},{"name":"window","unit":"s","transform":"ln","description":"planned fuel-off, seconds since flame onset (at_cutoff.planned_fuel_off_from_onset_s)"},{"name":"is_ethylene","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"1 when fuel = ethylene"},{"name":"x_fuel_stage","unit":"1","transform":"ln","description":"x_fuel of the first constant-flow segment of the schedule"},{"name":"v_fuel_stage","unit":"m/s","transform":"ln","description":"v_fuel_m_s of the first constant-flow segment of the schedule"}],"targets":[{"name":"loss","kind":"event","unit":null,"shared_quantity":null,"causes":["blowoff","other"],"scheduled_stop":{"condition":"planned_fuel_off_from_onset"},"description":"the flame goes out while the fuel still flows, seconds since flame onset"},{"name":"radiometer","kind":"positive","unit":"V","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"excess of the radiometer sum over its pre-ignition level in the first constant-flow stage (lane-local)"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
